faithfulness.description: Fraction of the agent answer that is grounded in retrieved context. Below 0.7 means the agent is likely hallucinating facts not present in the knowledge base.

answer_relevancy.description: How well the answer addresses the actual question. Below 0.6 means the agent is giving off-topic or incomplete responses.

justification.faithfulness_0.7: Set at 0.7 because our RAG pipeline should ground most claims in retrieved documents. 10% higher (0.8) would cause false failures on complex multi-hop questions. 10% lower (0.6) would allow too much hallucination through.
justification.answer_relevancy_0.6: Set at 0.6 to allow some flexibility since the agent reformats answers for a tutoring context. 10% higher (0.7) would fail valid paraphrased answers. 10% lower (0.5) would allow clearly off-topic responses.
